provenance.dividends: Nasdaq dividend-history API (api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/{TICKER}/dividends?assetclass=stocks): ex-dividend dates and cash amounts per share, captured 2026-09-22. Yahoo Finance reports the same corporate actions on the same ex-dates.
provenance.closes: Regular (unadjusted) closing prices for 2025-06-30, cross-checked between the Nasdaq chart API (api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/{TICKER}/chart) and East Money daily klines (fqt=0); both sources agree to the cent. Yahoo Finance raw Close is expected to be identical; its default dividend-adjusted Close is slightly lower and is absorbed by the evaluator's 5% price tolerance.
provenance.refresh: Run evaluation/build_snapshot.py on a host with Yahoo Finance access to regenerate this file from yfinance and diff it against the checked-in values.

boundary_notes.PEP: Ex-date 2024-12-06 (paid 2025-01-06) is outside the window and must not be counted; ex-date 2025-06-06 (paid 2025-06-30) is inside.
boundary_notes.CSCO: Ex-date 2025-01-03 is inside the window; ex-date 2025-07-03 is outside.
